source_type_reachability.scope: Static normal unmodified CupMemEngine.answer_query call path, not arbitrary helper calls or monkey-patched inputs

call_graph_evidence.finding: answer_query collects context, runs basis recovery and optional fallback, then calls _compose_answer.
_retrieve_query_topk emits active, stale, unknown; _retrieve_query_peripheral_topk at177 uses the same sources.
_run_basis_recovery uses only _rank_stale_unknown_basis_hits and _rank_global_item_value_hits; their candidate constructors emit stale/unknown and active/stale/unknown respectively.
_fallback_retrieve emits stale/unknown. Conflict retrieval uses existing same-source hits.
_build_topk_hit_bundles preserves primary_hit; chain_view and conflict families are nested metadata, not new primary_hit source types.
_build_canonical_answer_grounding copies _hit_ref(primary_hit); text is selected from that payload.
Action candidate preparation uses existing bundles; LLM-selected IDs map back to the bundle lookup, not newly invented source records.

source_type_reachability.limitation: Legacy source branches remain in helpers, but no reachable constructor produces those primary_hit sources in this revision. Unknown future types must stop adapter scoring as adapter gaps, never count as native CUPMem QA failures.

reader_design_caveat: The value-only source expansion is not a complete fair cited-QA prompt. A later common reader must explicitly present any native status/summary as model-derived annotations rather than source facts; stripping them could artificially degrade CUPMem. No new semantic prompt was implemented.
